name: PageCurlMeshRenderer
src_typeComment: 3D world-space equivalent of PageCurlGraphic — builds a real procedural Mesh instead of a UI mesh, using the same shared PageCurlMeshBuilder. Needs a material using the Toolkit/PageCurl/Unlit shader (or any shader that multiplies _MainTex by vertex color) for the self-shadow tint to actually show up — Unity's Standard shader ignores vertex colors by default. Requires pivot-equivalent alignment: this object's own local origin must be the hinge edge (localX = 0), same convention as PageCurlGraphic's rect.xMin.

src_serialized.name: gridColumns
src_serialized.tooltip: Grid density for the curl mesh — higher looks smoother but costs more vertices/triangles.

src_serialized.name: shadowDarkness
src_serialized.tooltip: Brightness multiplier applied to the page's underside as it curls past the halfway point.
